items_yield_factor.name: items_yield_factor
items_yield_factor.value: yield_factor is null or (yield_factor > 0 and yield_factor <= 1)

locations_temp_required.name: locations_temp_required
locations_temp_required.value: kind not in ('CHILLED', 'FROZEN') or (temp_min_c is not null and temp_max_c is not null)

locations_temp_order.name: locations_temp_order
locations_temp_order.value: temp_min_c is null or temp_max_c is null or temp_min_c <= temp_max_c
